## Invoice Editor

The one Commerce concept that's a UI, not a data model. `invoice.gts` already models line items via the realm's existing `LineItem` FieldDef; this component gives a consumer a pre-send EDITING surface for them (add/remove/adjust rows, live running total via `sumLineItems`) rather than only the read-only rendering `invoice.gts`'s own isolated view provides.

### Non-goals
Does not itself save the Invoice — takes `@lineItems`/`@onChange`, the consumer decides when/how to persist.

### Example
No linked example yet — pending a real Invoice instance to edit.
